$comment: DuckDB built-in functions (plan-links WP-D). Same shape as sqlite-functions.json; table functions list their output columns.

functions.name: length
functions.doc: Number of characters in the string.

functions.name: strlen
functions.doc: Number of bytes in the string.

functions.name: bit_length
functions.doc: Number of bits in the string.

functions.name: octet_length
functions.doc: Number of bytes in a blob.

functions.name: lpad
functions.doc: Pads the string on the left to count characters.

functions.name: rpad
functions.doc: Pads the string on the right to count characters.

functions.name: substring
functions.doc: Substring from a 1-based position, optionally limited to length characters.

functions.name: concat
functions.doc: Concatenates values; NULL values are skipped.

functions.name: concat_ws
functions.doc: Concatenates values with a separator; NULL values are skipped.

functions.name: replace
functions.doc: Replaces every occurrence of source with target.

functions.name: position
functions.doc: 1-based position of search in string, 0 when absent.

functions.name: strpos
functions.doc: 1-based position of search in string, 0 when absent.

functions.name: instr
functions.doc: 1-based position of search in string, 0 when absent.

functions.name: starts_with
functions.doc: True when string starts with prefix.

functions.name: prefix
functions.doc: True when string starts with prefix.

functions.name: ends_with
functions.doc: True when string ends with suffix.

functions.name: suffix
functions.doc: True when string ends with suffix.

functions.name: ilike_escape
functions.doc: Case-insensitive LIKE with an escape character.

functions.name: not_like_escape
functions.doc: NOT LIKE with an escape character.

functions.name: split_part
functions.doc: The index-th (1-based) part of the string split at separator.

functions.name: string_split
functions.doc: Splits the string into a list at separator.

functions.name: string_split_regex
functions.doc: Splits the string into a list at matches of a regular expression.

functions.name: regexp_matches
functions.doc: True when the string matches the regular expression anywhere.

functions.name: regexp_full_match
functions.doc: True when the whole string matches the regular expression.

functions.name: regexp_replace
functions.doc: Replaces the first match (all with the 'g' option).

functions.name: regexp_extract
functions.doc: Extracts a capture group of the first match.

functions.name: regexp_extract_all
functions.doc: Extracts a capture group of every match.

functions.name: translate
functions.doc: Replaces each character of from with the one at the same place in to.

functions.name: initcap
functions.doc: Capitalises the first letter of every word.

functions.name: ascii
functions.doc: Unicode code point of the first character.

functions.name: chr
functions.doc: Character of a Unicode code point.

functions.name: unicode
functions.doc: Unicode code point of the first character.

functions.name: ord
functions.doc: Unicode code point of the first character.

functions.name: hash
functions.doc: Non-cryptographic hash of one or more values.

functions.name: hamming
functions.doc: Number of differing positions of two equal-length strings.

functions.name: jaccard
functions.doc: Jaccard similarity of the character sets.

functions.name: has_accents
functions.doc: True when the string contains accented characters.

functions.name: bar
functions.doc: Draws a text bar chart value.

functions.name: to_base
functions.doc: Number in the given radix (2 to 36).

functions.name: list_aggr
functions.doc: Applies the named aggregate to the list elements.

functions.name: sign
functions.doc: -1, 0 or 1 by the sign of x.

functions.name: ceil
functions.doc: Rounds up to the next integer.

functions.name: floor
functions.doc: Rounds down to the previous integer.

functions.name: round
functions.doc: Rounds to digits decimal places (half away from zero).

functions.name: fmod
functions.doc: Remainder with the sign of the dividend.

functions.name: greatest
functions.doc: Largest of the arguments (NULLs are skipped).

functions.name: least
functions.doc: Smallest of the arguments (NULLs are skipped).

functions.name: nextafter
functions.doc: Next representable value after x towards y.

functions.name: lgamma
functions.doc: Natural logarithm of the gamma function.

functions.name: isfinite
functions.doc: True when x is neither NaN nor infinite.

functions.name: bitstring
functions.doc: Pads a bit string to length.

functions.name: typeof
functions.doc: DuckDB type name of the expression.

functions.name: cast
functions.doc: Converts to type; an error when impossible.

functions.name: try_cast
functions.doc: Converts to type; NULL when impossible.

functions.name: try
functions.doc: NULL instead of an error when the expression fails.

functions.name: strptime
functions.doc: Parses a string with a format; an error when it does not match.

functions.name: try_strptime
functions.doc: Parses a string with a format; NULL when it does not match.

functions.name: ifnull
functions.doc: x, or y when x is NULL.

functions.name: nullif
functions.doc: NULL when x = y, else x.

functions.name: if
functions.doc: then when the condition is true, else else.

functions.name: get_current_timestamp
functions.doc: Current timestamp (not frozen by the transaction).

functions.name: extract
functions.doc: Extracts a part of a date or timestamp.

functions.name: date_diff
functions.doc: Number of part boundaries crossed between two dates.

functions.name: date_sub
functions.doc: Number of complete parts between two dates.

functions.name: date_add
functions.doc: Adds an interval to a date.

functions.name: age
functions.doc: Symbolic difference (years, months, days); from today when one argument.

functions.name: epoch_ms
functions.doc: Milliseconds since the epoch to TIMESTAMP, or a TIMESTAMP to milliseconds.

functions.name: to_timestamp
functions.doc: Seconds since the epoch to a timestamp.

functions.name: make_timestamptz
functions.doc: Builds a timestamp with time zone.

functions.name: yearweek
functions.doc: Year and ISO week as YYYYWW.

functions.name: time_bucket
functions.doc: Truncates to a bucket of the given width.

functions.name: timezone_hour
functions.doc: Hour part of the zone offset.

functions.name: timezone_minute
functions.doc: Minute part of the zone offset.

functions.name: list_value
functions.doc: Builds a list from its arguments.

functions.name: list_transform
functions.doc: Applies a lambda to every element: list_transform(l, x -> x + 1).

functions.name: list_filter
functions.doc: Keeps the elements for which the lambda is true.

functions.name: list_reduce
functions.doc: Folds the list with a two-argument lambda.

functions.name: list_sort
functions.doc: Sorts the list ('ASC' or 'DESC', 'NULLS FIRST' or 'NULLS LAST').

functions.name: list_reverse_sort
functions.doc: Sorts the list in descending order.

functions.name: list_contains
functions.doc: True when the list contains the element.

functions.name: list_has_any
functions.doc: True when the lists share an element.

functions.name: list_has_all
functions.doc: True when list1 contains every element of list2.

functions.name: list_position
functions.doc: 1-based position of the element, NULL when absent.

functions.name: list_resize
functions.doc: Resizes the list, padding with value (NULL by default).

functions.name: list_zip
functions.doc: Pairs the elements of several lists.

functions.name: list_where
functions.doc: Elements of value_list where the mask is true.

functions.name: list_select
functions.doc: Elements of value_list at the given indexes.

functions.name: list_grade_up
functions.doc: Indexes that would sort the list.

functions.name: list_aggregate
functions.doc: Applies the named aggregate (sum, min, max, avg…) to the elements.

functions.name: array_to_string
functions.doc: Joins the elements with a separator.

functions.name: range
functions.doc: List from start to stop (exclusive); also usable as a table function.

functions.name: generate_series
functions.doc: List from start to stop (inclusive); also usable as a table function.

functions.name: unnest
functions.doc: Expands a list into one row per element.

functions.name: cardinality
functions.doc: Number of entries of a map.

functions.name: array_length
functions.doc: Number of elements of a list.

functions.name: struct_pack
functions.doc: Builds a struct from named values.

functions.name: struct_update
functions.doc: Adds or replaces fields of a struct.

functions.name: struct_contains
functions.doc: True when a field has the value.

functions.name: struct_position
functions.doc: 1-based position of a field with the value.

functions.name: map
functions.doc: Builds a map from a list of keys and a list of values.

functions.name: map_from_entries
functions.doc: Builds a map from a list of {key, value} structs.

functions.name: map_extract
functions.doc: Value of a key as a one-element list.

functions.name: map_extract_value
functions.doc: Value of a key, NULL when absent.

functions.name: union_value
functions.doc: Builds a UNION value with a tag.

functions.name: union_extract
functions.doc: Value of a UNION when it has the tag.

functions.name: json_extract
functions.doc: Extracts a value at a JSON path ('$.a.b[0]').

functions.name: json_extract_string
functions.doc: Extracts a value at a JSON path as text.

functions.name: json_value
functions.doc: Scalar value at a JSON path.

functions.name: json_exists
functions.doc: True when the JSON path exists.

functions.name: json_valid
functions.doc: True when the text is valid JSON.

functions.name: json_array_length
functions.doc: Number of elements of a JSON array.

functions.name: json_transform
functions.doc: Converts JSON into the given structure.

functions.name: json_serialize_sql
functions.doc: Parses a SELECT statement to a JSON syntax tree.

functions.name: json_deserialize_sql
functions.doc: SQL text of a serialised SELECT.

functions.name: json_group_array
functions.doc: Aggregate: JSON array of the values.

functions.name: json_group_object
functions.doc: Aggregate: JSON object of key/value pairs.

functions.name: enum_range
functions.doc: All values of an enum type.

functions.name: enum_first
functions.doc: First value of an enum type.

functions.name: enum_last
functions.doc: Last value of an enum type.

functions.name: bit_position
functions.doc: Position of a sub bit string.

functions.name: error
functions.doc: Raises an error with the message.

functions.name: count
functions.doc: Number of rows (count(*)) or non-NULL values.

functions.name: arg_min
functions.doc: The arg of the row with the smallest val.

functions.name: arg_max
functions.doc: The arg of the row with the largest val.

functions.name: arg_min_null
functions.doc: arg_min that also considers NULL args.

functions.name: arg_max_null
functions.doc: arg_max that also considers NULL args.

functions.name: any_value
functions.doc: Some non-NULL value of the group.

functions.name: string_agg
functions.doc: Concatenates the values with a separator; supports ORDER BY inside.

functions.name: list
functions.doc: Collects the values into a list; supports ORDER BY inside.

functions.name: histogram
functions.doc: Map of value to number of occurrences.

functions.name: histogram_exact
functions.doc: Counts of the listed values only.

functions.name: bool_and
functions.doc: True when every value is true.

functions.name: bool_or
functions.doc: True when any value is true.

functions.name: bitstring_agg
functions.doc: Bit string with the bits of the values set.

functions.name: countif
functions.doc: Number of rows where the condition is true.

functions.name: count_if
functions.doc: Number of rows where the condition is true.

functions.name: quantile
functions.doc: Interpolated quantile; pos in [0, 1] or a list of positions.

functions.name: entropy
functions.doc: Shannon entropy of the value distribution.

functions.name: regr_count
functions.doc: Number of pairs with both values non-NULL.

functions.name: regr_avgx
functions.doc: Average of x over non-NULL pairs.

functions.name: regr_avgy
functions.doc: Average of y over non-NULL pairs.

functions.name: regr_sxy
functions.doc: Sum of products of x and y.

functions.name: fsum
functions.doc: Floating point sum with Kahan summation.

functions.name: favg
functions.doc: Floating point average with Kahan summation.

functions.name: reservoir_quantile
functions.doc: Approximate quantile from a reservoir sample.

functions.name: row_number
functions.doc: Number of the row within its partition, from 1.

functions.name: cume_dist
functions.doc: Fraction of rows up to and including the current peers.

functions.name: ntile
functions.doc: Splits the partition into buckets and returns the bucket number.

functions.name: lag
functions.doc: Value offset rows before the current row.

functions.name: lead
functions.doc: Value offset rows after the current row.

functions.name: first_value
functions.doc: Value at the first row of the frame (IGNORE NULLS supported).

functions.name: last_value
functions.doc: Value at the last row of the frame.

functions.name: nth_value
functions.doc: Value at the n-th row of the frame.

functions.name: fill
functions.doc: Fills NULLs by interpolating between neighbours.

functions.name: json_tree
functions.doc: Every node of a JSON document.

operators.doc: JSON / struct field access returning JSON; also the lambda arrow: x -> x + 1.
Not a regular expression full match.
The left list contains every element of the right list.
The left list is contained in the right list.
